artworks.title: Desiderius Erasmus
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a bust view, seated and facing slightly to his left with a serene expression. He has defined facial features, short wavy hair, and wears a fur-trimmed cloak. The background has a detailed textured pattern.

artworks.title: Desiderius Erasmus
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a man seated with his hands crossed in front of him. His face is shown in profile to the left, with prominent cheekbones, a pointed nose, and a slightly furrowed brow. He has visible wrinkles around his eyes and mouth. His hair appears to be short and curly underneath a round, flat cap. He is wearing a long, dark robe with a thick, fur collar, and a light fabric wrapped around his neck. There is no jewelry visible. The background is a plain, textured surface, and the bottom of the image has text that reads "DESIDERIUS ERASMUS ROTTERODAMUS".

artworks.title: Desiderius Erasmus
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image shows an upper half portrait of Desiderius Erasmus Rotterodamus. He is seated with his body slightly turned towards the left. His facial features are distinct, with a long straight nose, prominent cheekbones, and a slight smile. He has wavy hair that peeks out from underneath a large, soft hat that fits snugly on his head. He is wearing a coat with a luxurious fur trim, and his hands are folded gently in front of him, partially covered by the coat's long sleeves. The background of the image is a simple, textured surface. The name "Desiderius Erasmus Rotterodamus" is prominently displayed at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Richard Kingston, Political Pamphleteer, Chaplain to Charles I
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman or Lucas Vorsterman II
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man. He is portrayed from the chest up, facing slightly left and looking directly at the viewer. The man has long, wavy hair, a high forehead, large eyes, and a firm mouth. He is wearing a dark garment with a white collar. Surrounding the person's image is an ornamental border with text, and in the background, there are books and possibly a curtain, indicating an interior space with elements suggestive of study. A coat of arms with intricate designs is visible on the left side.

artworks.title: William, First Duke of Newcastle
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man with only his shoulders and head visible. He is facing slightly to the right while his body is turned slightly to the left. The man has a long face with strong cheekbones, a narrow mustache, and wavy hair that falls to his shoulders. He is wearing a high-collared shirt with a large decorative ruffle and a doublet or coat detailed on the shoulders and chest. Two decorative loops hang from his clothing at the shoulders, and he wears a medallion around his neck. The background consists of an oval frame with Latin text surrounding the portrait, engraved in a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Thomas Howard, Third Duke of Norfolk
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman after Hans Holbein the Elder
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in an upper body portrait, facing slightly to the viewer's right, holding a staff in each hand. He has a long face with a solemn expression, short, wavy hair, and a large hat. He wears a richly decorated garment with a broad, ornate fur collar and a garment clasp across his chest. He has a chain with a decorative medallion around his neck. The background has a textured, cross-hatched pattern.

artworks.title: Abraham Aurelius, Minister of the French Church in London
artworks.artist: Robert van Voerst
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing from just below the waist up. He is in a poised position, with his left hand resting on a table holding an open book and his right hand holding a closed book. The man has a full beard and mustache, closely cropped hair, and a solemn expression. He is wearing a period-appropriate robe with large sleeves, detailed buttons, and a ruffled collar. There is no visible jewelry. The background has a vertical textured pattern on the right side. The portrait is framed by text above and below.

artworks.title: Christian, Duke of Brunswick
artworks.artist: Robert van Voerst after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man from the waist up, posed in a three-quarter view to the right. He has loose, wavy hair that falls to his collar, framing a face with a serious expression, featuring a mustache and fine features. He is dressed in a detailed outfit, wearing armor adorned with studs or rivets and a sash draped over one shoulder, with a large collar that appears to be made of lace. He has a long sword visible by his side that is decorated with an emblem near the hilt. In the background, there are depictions of foliage and clouds, adding a touch of nature and depth to the portrait's setting.

artworks.title: William Fielding, First Earl of Denbigh
artworks.artist: Robert van Voerst after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a bust-length portrait within an oval frame. He is facing slightly to the right with a serious expression. He has a beard, mustache, long curly hair, and wears an elaborate outfit with a lace collar, doublet, and sash. The portrait is highly detailed with intricate line work, and the background inside the oval frame has a dot and line pattern. There is a decorative border with text in capital letters surrounding the oval. Below the image, there is a wider border with a script revealing the man's name, titles, engraver's attribution, and the year "1631".

artworks.title: Edward Sackville, Fourth Earl of Dorset
artworks.artist: Robert van Voerst after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with a composed facial expression. He has curly hair, a mustache, and a goatee. He is dressed in an ornate outfit with elaborate details. The background features an oval frame with an inscription identifying the man as Edward Sackville.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth
artworks.artist: Attributed to Robert van Voerst
artworks.description: The image features an engraved depiction of a woman with intricate details in her clothing and accessories. She is shown from the waist up, seated or in a royal pose, facing slightly to her left. The woman has an oval face, arched eyebrows, and a small mouth. Her hair is styled in voluminous curls, adorned with pearls and a large crown. She wears a richly decorated gown with puffed sleeves and a high lace ruff collar. There are pearls around her neck and she holds a scepter in her right hand and an orb in her left. The background includes inscriptions and additional text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Prince Frederick Henry Bavaria
artworks.artist: Attributed to Robert van Voerst
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a young man facing forward with his head slightly turned to his left. He has a serene expression, delicate facial features, and medium-length curly hair framing his face. He wears an elaborate garment typical of the early 17th century, including a high, pleated white ruff collar, a richly patterned doublet with vertical lines and buttons, and puffed shoulder pads. The young man is not holding any objects or wearing jewelry. The background is intricately etched with lines within an oval frame. Latin inscriptions and an English title describe him as "The most illustrious Prince Frederick Henry."

artworks.title: Charles Louis, Elector Palatine
artworks.artist: Robert van Voerst
artworks.description: This image shows a black and white engraved portrait of a man. The man is positioned to the left, looking ahead with curly, shoulder-length hair. His facial features include eyes, nose, and lips. He wears a detailed outfit with a lace collar and a garment suggesting formality, possibly armor. A sash is draped across his chest. The portrait is framed in an oval with inscriptions around the border and decorative text at the bottom providing details about the man's titles and affiliations. The background is blank.

artworks.title: Robert Bertie, First Earl of Lindsey, Royalist, Fell at Edgehill
artworks.artist: Robert van Voerst after Georg Geldorp
artworks.description: The image contains a portrait of a man from the chest up, positioned facing the viewer slightly to the right. His face features high cheekbones, a pointed beard, and a receding hairline. The sides of his head have wavy hair. He wears an elaborate collar with lace detailing and a decorated cloak with intricate patterns. The background has a decorative oval frame with inscriptions and heraldic elements at the top, including a coat of arms. Ornate scrollwork and stylized motifs surround the portrait, contributing to its formal and historical style.

artworks.title: Robert Bertie, First Earl of Lindsey
artworks.artist: Robert van Voerst after Georg Geldorp
artworks.description: The image displays a man in a portrait engraving. He is portrayed from the chest up in a slightly angled seated position. The man has distinct facial features, including a high forehead, sharp nose, and pointed chin with facial hair consisting of a mustache and small goatee. His hair is thin, styled back to reveal a receding hairline. He is adorned with a detailed high-collared lace ruff around his neck, an ornate garment with embroidery and lace, and a diagonal sash across his shoulder. A buttoned doublet is visible under the outer garment. The engraving is oval-shaped with an inscription identifying the individual as Robert Bartu. Ornate script at the lower part of the image further confirms his noble status. The background is textured with fine lines, enhancing the intricate design.

artworks.title: Philip Herbert, Fourth Earl of Pembroke
artworks.artist: Robert van Voerst after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body in a seated position. He has wavy, shoulder-length hair and a neatly trimmed mustache and goatee. His clothing is elaborate, featuring a dark cloak with a large ornate collar and a badge with a cross emblem on his chest. His right hand is resting on an object while his left arm is mostly obscured. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Philip Herbert, Fourth Earl of Pembroke
artworks.artist: Robert van Voerst, after Daniel Mytens the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man in three-quarter view. He is depicted facing slightly to the right, with aristocratic facial features including a high forehead, sharp nose, a small mustache and beard. His hair is wavy and medium length, styled neatly. He wears an Elizabethan-style ruffled collar, a decorated doublet with small buttons and an ornate fabric pattern. A pendant with intricate detailing hangs around his neck. The background is filled with detailed line work and the portrait is encased in an oval frame with text indicating his noble titles.

artworks.title: James Stuart, Duke of Richmond and Lennox
artworks.artist: Robert van Voerst after Georg Geldorp
artworks.description: This is a portrait engraving of a young man visible from the waist up. He is facing toward the viewer with his body slightly angled to the right. His facial features include a youthful, smooth complexion with prominent cheekbones and a calm expression. He has straight, chin-length hair that frames his face evenly. The young man is wearing an elaborately detailed outfit, featuring a high lace collar and a buttoned doublet with intricate patterns and textures. No jewelry or objects are visible on him. The background consists of a simple, dark, oval frame around the portrait, with Latin text decorating the frame.

artworks.title: George Carew, Earl of Totnes
artworks.artist: Robert van Voerst
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up, standing upright. He is facing forward with a beard, mustache, and short gray or white hair. The man wears armor, a ruff collar, and a ruffled fabric around his neck. He holds a baton or scepter in his right hand. In the background, there is an ornate oval frame with classical elements and scrolls with inscriptions in Latin. The background features curtains and architectural elements with symbolic motifs.

artworks.title: Robert van Voerst
artworks.artist: Robert van Voerst after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a man seated in a three-quarter pose with his head turned slightly to the left. He has a contemplative expression on his face, medium-length, wavy hair, and a mustache. He is wearing a robe with wide sleeves and a ruffled shirt at the neckline, and holding a rolled-up paper or document. The background shows a simple wall with a vertical structure and a partly cloudy sky, with the inscription "ROBERTVS VAN VOERST, CALOGRAPHVS LONDINI" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Simon Vouet
artworks.artist: Robert van Voerst after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image is a three-quarters view of a man visible from the waist up. He is seated facing slightly to the left with his head turned towards the viewer. His facial features are detailed, with a mustache and a subtle beard, and he has curly hair falling around his ears. He is wearing a robe or cloak over a garment with a visible cuff at the wrist, showcasing rich textures. The man is holding a book with one hand, his fingers curling around the spine. The background has an engraved texture. Text below the portrait indicates he is Simon Vouet.

artworks.title: Robert Rich, Second Earl of Warwick
artworks.artist: Attributed to Robert van Voerst
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the chest up. He is depicted facing slightly to his left. The man has distinct facial features, with a mustache and a small goatee, and wavy hair that is styled back. He is wearing a detailed garment that includes armor and a lace collar. The portrait is encircled by an oval frame with inscriptions, and the background is textured. In the lower section, there is script text providing identification and titles attributed to the individual.

artworks.title: Robert Rich
artworks.artist: Attributed to Robert van Voerst
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man. He is shown from the upper body up, facing slightly to his left with calm expression. He has a neatly trimmed mustache and beard, curly medium-length hair, and is wearing period attire indicating nobility, possibly armor with a sash. The background is a simple pattern with an oval frame and text. The image is set on aged paper with an inscription at the bottom stating: "The Right Honourable Robert Rich, Earle of Warwike and Lord Rich of Leez, Admiral & Commander in Cheife of the sea Fleete."

artworks.title: Francis Bacon
artworks.artist: Unknown Artist
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated from the waist up, facing slightly to the left. He appears somber, with facial features including a mustache and beard. He wears a broad-brimmed hat with a decorative band, an ornate robe, and a lace collar. His left hand holds a piece of paper on his chest, while his right hand is partly visible. The background includes a decorative border and a crest with armored figures and symbols on a patterned backdrop.
